metadata.description: MAASAI Labs: 10 free, open-source (MIT) remote MCP plugins for Cursor.

plugins.name: safe-cap-table-mcp
plugins.description: Model any startup round in seconds: post- and pre-money SAFEs (cap, discount, MFN), convertible notes, priced rounds, multi-tranche and extension rounds at different caps, option pool top-ups (pre vs post-money) and advisor/placement fees. Returns before/after cap tables, per-holder dilution and fully diluted ownership, validated against YC's standard SAFE examples. Works for any market.

plugins.name: space-launch-tracker-mcp
plugins.description: Upcoming launches worldwide with live countdowns (Launch Library 2), Starship flight status and news, and visible ISS, Tiangong, Hubble and Starlink-train passes for any location using CelesTrak orbital data. Every answer cites its source and fetch time.

plugins.name: orbital-watch-mcp
plugins.description: Live satellite and debris tracking from CelesTrak, predicted close approaches (CelesTrak SOCRATES), and NOAA SWPC space weather (flares, Kp, geomagnetic storms, alerts) with plain-English impact on GPS, HF radio and Starlink. Informational only, sourced and timestamped.

plugins.name: breach-radar-mcp
plugins.description: Passive, public-data security checks: Have I Been Pwned breach lookups (email lookups only when the server operator has set an HIBP key), k-anonymous password checks, NIST CVE search, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, and a domain's public attack surface (security headers, TLS, SPF/DMARC/DNSSEC/CAA, certificate-transparency subdomains). No scanning or probing.

plugins.name: chip-intel-mcp
plugins.description: Source-cited AI accelerator specs and side-by-side comparisons (NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, AWS Trainium), a TSMC/Samsung/Intel process-node map, US export-control screening against the official Consolidated Screening List (incl. BIS Entity List), SEC filings and revenue for major chip companies, and chip news briefings. Every figure links to its source.

plugins.name: whatsapp-community-mcp
plugins.description: Run WhatsApp groups with your own Green API instance (optional WhatsApp Cloud API): list groups, read recent messages, summarise activity (top posters, busiest hours, unanswered questions, links), draft announcements, and post or schedule messages. Every send needs explicit confirmation; per-user isolated storage.

plugins.name: call-anyone-mcp
plugins.description: Plan and place outbound phone calls in the callee's language with your own Bland or Twilio account: language detection, goal-based script, cost estimate and a preview you must confirm before any call. Then fetch transcript and summary. The caller always discloses it's an AI; emergency and premium numbers are blocked.

plugins.name: prediction-odds-mcp
plugins.description: Live odds from Polymarket and Kalshi in one place: search markets by topic, trending markets by 24h volume, live top-of-book for any market, cross-venue comparisons that only match markets with identical resolution terms, and short briefings on the biggest moves. Read-only, sourced and timestamped; probabilities, not advice.

plugins.name: x-marketplace-seller-mcp
plugins.description: Sell items on X: create listings with a private floor and ceiling, draft buyer replies with intent and scam detection, run a negotiation engine that never goes below your floor or reveals it, draft pickup/delivery handoffs, and keep a deal ledger. Posting and DMs use your own X token, and every post, DM or deal needs explicit confirmation. Storage is isolated per user.

plugins.name: domain-hunter-mcp
plugins.description: Brainstorm brandable domain names from a product idea and check live availability through registry RDAP (WHOIS fallback) with Porkbun list prices. Also does registration lookups with expiry/drop signals, DNS records with an SPF/DMARC check, live TLS certificate details and TLD pricing. It never buys anything; purchase links are returned only on request.
